cells.gaps: No report, review or evaluation against the policy's targets is held. No adoption date is stated: the text carries a presidential foreword and signature block, and a 2023-10 report (ZWE-015) still describes the policy as developed with no launch date. The body and finance facts (ZWE-008, ZWE-009) are dated 2022, outside the 36-month window, so governance is empty. An ICT Policy 2026-2030 is named once (ZWE-001) with no standing or text on record and places nothing.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2022-2027: adopted, text public, period running to 2027, with an uncosted implementation plan of actions. Stage 4 needs a published report of results against the policy within three years, and none is held.
